name: You
bio: Competent, but no myth yet. You drive because driving is useful, available and familiar. Your family is gone and nobody ever gave you a satisfying answer.

name: Mira Sol
bio: Believes a road is valuable because nobody owns the destination. Her confidence hides a fear that stability will erase who she is.

name: Ren Akiyama
bio: Driven by evidence, not revenge. Afraid that emotion will corrupt the investigation. Asks whether facts are enough when people are hurting.

name: Kai Mercer
bio: Measures his worth through performance. A healthy rivalry that turns toxic only if it is fed with humiliation, secrecy or favoritism.

name: Lena Voss
bio: Understands networks of people better than networks of machines. Her question: should information be public by default?

name: Noah Arden
bio: Not morally perfect. Sometimes picks stability over truth because he has watched ordinary people suffer when institutions collapse.

name: Lucien Vale
bio: Persuasive, generous and publicly admired. Aster really did make roads safer. Unlock through the story.

name: Sera Vale
bio: Disagrees with her father's methods. Internal reformer or rival executive, depending on you.

name: Jun Park
bio: Built components later used in early prototypes. A garage ally.

name: Nami Kuro
bio: Protects the old roads from corporate closure. Touge faction leader.
